text:
maria_g: FYI vendor 'Orchid Logistics' invoice 98765 posted but failed PO match — vendor code on invoice is ORCH-LGC instead of ORCH-LOG. Routing sent to AP-ops instead of Procurement. Attaching PDF.

alex_k: Can you drop the invoice link? I can re-map vendor code in Coupa and requeue if needed.

maria_g: Link: https://invoices.redwood.internal/98765.pdf — system shows PO 45000123 but approver list is empty (no procurement approver).

finance-bot: Invoice 98765 received. Status: PO mismatch. Suggested action: manual vendor-code remap and reprocess. Ticket recommendation: INV-4512.

liam_p: If vendor code changed we need a vendor master update + reprocess the invoice. @alex_k can you request the vendor master change? Vendor TAX ID: 12-3456789, remit to same account.

alex_k: On it. I opened ticket INV-4512 to update vendor code mapping (ORCH-LGC -> ORCH-LOG). ETA today EOD. Will re-queue invoice after the change and confirm in this thread.

maria_g: Also noticed the invoice posted to GL 5602 (consulting/services) but expense should be GL 5420 (cloud hosting). Can we update allocation during reprocess? Need this for month-end close.

liam_p: Noted. @finance-bot please flag PO 45000123 for GL reallocation to 5420 after vendor remap and reprocessing.

finance-bot: Action queued: INV-4512 created by alex_k. Next steps: vendor master update -> reprocess invoice -> set GL to 5420 -> route to Procurement approver group. ETA EOD. Will post updates here.

alex_k: :thumbsup: I added the GL change to the ticket notes and requested expedited processing. If procurement approver lookup still fails, will escalate to @maria_g for manual approval.

maria_g: Thanks. If anything blocks escalation ping me. I'll keep an eye for the reprocessed invoice so we don't miss cut-off.
